stations.title: Theo
stations.say: What does this order come to?

stations.title: The till
stations.text: Charges the same total every time.

captions: The shelf count works. Now Theo wants the first order of the day priced.
He does the sums on his phone, and last week he was a cent out.
You write the sums in prices.js, in four small tasks.
Now the order is priced in whole cents, with the discount, shipping and boxes.
The same sums every time. Theo charges right, and Ines knows how many boxes to fold.
